entries.2a0f2cbc35c3a318: This is a family event, started in July 2024, that is the real-world version of “Gokko Land.” It provides workshops, quiz rallies, photo spots and other activities at large malls and commercial facilities. It earns revenue from both the companies that open stores and the facilities that host the events. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, it was held at 30 locations (63 sessions in total), and cumulative visitors exceeded 65,000. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥106 million.
entries.2a82db48d673f3a1: These include the regional experience guidebook “Jimoto Guide,” and “Service Design,” which provides business development support and commissioned development. “Jimoto Guide” is a digital guidebook operated within “Gokko Land,” and it collects store fees from local governments and local companies. “Service Design” supports the digital use of content assets, such as characters, of client companies, and it earns revenue under development support contracts and similar agreements. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥121 million.

entries.c46fbfbf26f20391: This is a social experience app that allows children to simulate working on smart devices through pretend play. Child users can use it for free, and the company collects store fees from companies and organizations that open stores. As of the end of December 2025, cumulative downloads exceeded 8,000,000, and the number of pavilion stores was 96. It also operates an overseas version of the app, “Gokko World,” and conducts sales activities targeting local and Japanese companies through its consolidated subsidiary, a Vietnamese local subsidiary. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥929 million.
